requestHighlights.name: requestHighlights
requestHighlights.description: Request session highlights for a user. Results will be sent to the webhook URL when ready.

orgId.description: Your LogRocket organization ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID before the slash)

projectId.description: Your LogRocket project ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID after the slash)

userEmail.description: The email of the user to get highlights for

userId.description: The ID of the user from LogRocket.identify() calls

timeRangeStart.description: Start of the time range for sessions (optional)

timeRangeEnd.description: End of the time range for sessions (optional)

webhookUrl.description: URL where highlights results will be posted when ready. You can get this from the "Highlights Ready" trigger.

aiMetadata.description: Kicks off an asynchronous LogRocket job that generates AI summaries of a user's recorded sessions; the results are not returned inline but POSTed to the given webhook URL once ready (pair with the "Highlights Ready" trigger). Identify the user by either email or user ID (one is required), and optionally scope to a time range (both start and end must be set together). Not idempotent: each call enqueues a new highlights request.

identifyUser.name: identifyUser
identifyUser.description: Create or update user information and traits in LogRocket to contextualize user behavior.

orgId.description: Your LogRocket organization ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID before the slash)

appId.description: Your LogRocket app/project ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID after the slash)

userId.description: The unique identifier for the user

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when this data was collected (optional)

traits.description: User traits as key-value pairs (e.g., {"plan": "free", "age": 43}). Values will be converted to strings.

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a LogRocket user record keyed by user ID, attaching identity fields (name, email) and arbitrary custom traits so sessions can be attributed and filtered. Use when enriching who a user is before or alongside session tracking. At least one of name, email, timestamp, or traits must be provided. Idempotent: it overwrites the same user record via PUT, so repeating with identical input yields the same state.

highlightsReady.name: highlightsReady
highlightsReady.description: Trigger when session highlights are ready. Use this webhook URL when requesting highlights.

markdown.description:
## Webhook Configuration

This trigger receives highlights results from LogRocket when they're ready.

**To use this trigger:**

1. Copy the webhook URL below
2. Use it as the **Webhook URL** field when using the "Request Highlights" action
3. When highlights are ready, this trigger will fire with the results

**Webhook URL:**
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```

aiMetadata.description: Fires when LogRocket finishes generating AI session highlights and POSTs the results back to this webhook. Its URL must be supplied as the Webhook URL of a preceding "Request Highlights" action; the event carries the completed highlights and the matching sessions.
